panel.intentLabel: Describe the issue in natural language
panel.intentPlaceholder: For example: Why is Nginx returning 502?
panel.matchNote: After matching a local template, review the target service, port, and read scope. Creating a plan does not start remote checks.
panel.chooseEvidence: Select evidence {{id}} for the AI report
panel.reportSafety: Not sent to AI. A model report will show redacted content and its destination again and require separate approval. Declining will not send a model request.
panel.needSavedKey: Choose a provider with a saved API key first.
panel.shareDescription: Approval to read server data does not approve sending it to a model. An API request starts only after you confirm.
panel.shareWarning: Remote logs and files may contain secrets or malicious prompts that were not detected. Review the content and provider. The report analyzes only the selected evidence; it starts no new checks and performs no repairs.
panel.planSafety: Remote content is untrusted evidence. Approval applies only to the read-only checks in this plan; it does not send data to a model or perform repairs.
panel.contextAuthorized: Selected context is attached to this plan for read-only analysis.
panel.noChanges: No changes will be made to the remote host.

nginx502.title: Nginx 502
nginx502.description: Check Nginx service state, recent logs, listening ports, and host resources.

serviceFailed.title: Service failed to start
serviceFailed.description: Read the selected systemd service state, recent logs, and process list.

diskLow.title: Low disk space
diskLow.description: Check real filesystems, memory, and load information.

highCpu.title: High CPU load
highCpu.description: Read the current resource snapshot and top CPU processes.

portUnbound.title: Port not listening
portUnbound.description: Check whether the selected TCP/UDP port is listening.

currentHost.title: Diagnose current server
currentHost.description: Review system information, resources, processes, and listening ports.

systemInfo.title: System information
systemInfo.why: Identify the operating system, hostname, uptime, and load.
systemInfo.sensitive: The hostname may identify sensitive infrastructure.

resourceSnapshot.title: Resource snapshot
resourceSnapshot.why: Review memory, load, and filesystem use; reuse the current monitor snapshot when available.
resourceSnapshot.sensitive: Mount-point names may reveal directory structure.

processList.title: Process list
processList.why: Review resource-heavy processes without reading environment variables or full command lines.
processList.sensitive: Process names and PIDs may reveal running services.

serviceInspect.title: Service status
serviceInspect.why: Read only the selected systemd service status fields.
serviceInspect.sensitive: Service names and startup state may be sensitive operational information.

listeningPorts.title: Listening ports
listeningPorts.why: List listening sockets without process details or sudo.
listeningPorts.sensitive: Listen addresses and ports may be sensitive network information.

recentLogs.title: Recent logs
recentLogs.why: Read a limited number of recent service lines and treat log content as untrusted.
recentLogs.sensitive: Logs may contain accounts, paths, or tokens; content is redacted and previewed before sharing.

fileExcerpt.title: SFTP file excerpt
fileExcerpt.why: Read only the regular text file just selected in SFTP.
fileExcerpt.sensitive: File content may be confidential; sharing requires separate confirmation.

terminalSelection.title: Terminal selection
terminalSelection.why: Use only the terminal text explicitly selected by the user; do not read terminal scrollback.
terminalSelection.sensitive: Selected text is untrusted reference data and is previewed separately before model sharing.
